_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Cloudflare http_request_cache_settings ruleset fronting the TC-ATLAS API (api.tcatlas.org). Apply with `python3 cloudflare/apply_cache_ruleset.py`; verify with `cloudflare/verify_cache.sh`. The auth token lives in GCP Secret Manager (secret `cloudflare-rules-token`); the zone_id/ruleset_id below are identifiers, not secrets. See README.md for the design rationale and CF API gotchas.

rules.description: tc-atlas: CACHE slow-changing JSON (active-storms, season-summary, ALL weatherlab-genesis* incl the ~20MB immutable spaghetti, weatherlab-global) respect origin max-age. The genesis base + global payloads were previously bypassed (DYNAMIC) so every global-map visitor pulled them from Cloud Run origin; the origin already stamps them immutable/short max-age so edge-caching is safe and cuts origin egress. EXCEPTION: /weatherlab-genesis-cycles (the cycle-picker list) is excluded so a freshly-published DeepMind cycle appears in the picker immediately instead of after its 5-min max-age; it is tiny (~800 B) so the extra origin hits are negligible.
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org") and (http.request.uri.path contains "/active-storms" or http.request.uri.path contains "/season-summary" or (http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-genesis" and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "-cycles")) or http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-global")

rules.description: tc-atlas: BYPASS live/no-store endpoints (per-storm /weatherlab + /weatherlab-ensemble, recon, shear). All /weatherlab-genesis* and /weatherlab-global are EXCLUDED here so they fall through to the CACHE rule above.
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org") and (http.request.method ne "GET" or (http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab" and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-genesis" or http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-global")) or http.request.uri.path contains "/recon" or http.request.uri.path contains "/shear")

rules.description: tc-atlas: CACHE frame endpoints (respect origin max-age)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org") and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "band-raw-frame") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "ir-raw-frame") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "ir-frame.jpg"))

rules.description: tc-atlas: CACHE cdn JSON manifests + immutable genesis payloads (.json not in CF default extension set -> was DYNAMIC; mosaic frames.json + rt raw-frames manifest.json send max-age=60; /genesis/*.json are content-addressed per-cycle & immutable/max-age=86400 -> the ~23MB DeepMind spaghetti was re-pulled from R2 origin by EVERY global-map visitor because the edge would not cache it)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "cdn.tcatlas.org") and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/frames.json") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/manifest.json") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/genesis/") and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".json")))
